Pallavi Banerjee
Mobile-first React Native Engineer | New Delhi
pallavi.banerjee5@example.com | +91 9205326630

Experienced React Native developer focused on building performant mobile apps with TypeScript and modern engineering practices. Comfortable working in Agile teams, delivering features end-to-end from design handoff to release and monitoring. Seeking to continue shipping user-facing mobile experiences and improving developer workflows. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience
Bluefin Logistics — Mar 2022 - Present
React Native Developer, Remote
- Implemented end-to-end delivery tracking features using React Native and TypeScript, reducing location sync errors by 35% and improving live ETA accuracy for drivers and customers.
- Built offline-first delivery manifest and reconciliation flows with local persistence and background sync, cutting failed delivery updates by 28% and enabling smoother network recovery.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints to refactor core navigation and state management, decreasing app cold start time by 22% and crash rate by 18% through targeted fixes and Git-based release gating.
- Led peer code reviews and introduced TypeScript linting and stricter Git branch policies, which improved deploy frequency and reduced hotfixes after releases.

Razorpay — Feb 2021 - Feb 2022
React Native Developer, Hybrid
- Developed payment-related UI components in React Native and TS for merchant onboarding flows, increasing completed onboarding conversions by 14%.
- Integrated card scanning and secure input components to streamline checkout experiences, reducing form abandonment by 20% while maintaining PCI-related constraints.
- Worked in cross-functional Agile squads to ship bi-weekly releases; wrote unit and integration tests and used Git workflows to coordinate feature branches and release hotfixes.
- Optimized bundle size and memory usage in React Native screens, lowering median screen render time by 30% on target devices.

Projects
- Delivery Insights Dashboard (side project): Built a React Native prototype in TS to visualize rider KPIs and route efficiency; demonstrated potential for a 10% route optimization in pilot tests.
- Offline Sync Library: Created a small reusable module to queue and retry network requests in flaky conditions, adopted informally by team to improve background sync reliability.
